Dear Pulse Foundation Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing & Communications Operations Lead position. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your mission of fostering entrepreneurship.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I have also implemented AI-assisted workflows and automations to streamline tasks, which aligns with your focus on leveraging AI to enhance efficiency. My experience with tools like Canva, Mailchimp, and Google Analytics, combined with my technical skills, makes me well-suited to manage your communication strategy and optimize operations.

I am particularly drawn to Pulse Foundation's impact on the Belgian entrepreneurial ecosystem and the chance to shape enduring processes. I am eager to bring my organizational skills and data-driven mindset to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing & Communications Operations Lead position at Pulse Foundation. As a digital marketer with a technical foundation in SEO, web development, and AI-assisted workflows, I am drawn to your mission of fostering entrepreneurship and creating impactful experiences. Your focus on leveraging AI to automate recurring tasks resonates with my own approach to efficiency and innovation.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed skills in content creation, SEO, and website management. I have successfully built and maintained client websites using WordPress, Elementor, and Astra, and have implemented structured data and entity optimization to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. My experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs has enabled me to make data-driven decisions to enhance organic traffic and engagement.

I am particularly excited about the opportunity to manage the editorial calendar for LinkedIn and Instagram, create engaging content, and oversee recruitment campaigns. My ability to work autonomously and manage multiple projects simultaneously will allow me to thrive in your fast-paced environment. Additionally, my familiarity with CRM tools and automation platforms like Zapier/Make will enable me to design and deploy AI agents to streamline tasks, as you envision.

I am eager to contribute to Pulse Foundation's visibility and impact, and to mentor interns while maintaining a high-level focus on strategic goals. My professional English, combined with my ongoing Dutch studies, will support effective communication with your diverse audience.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
